features.quote: continues for the full turn budget or until the model produces a terminal statement ("I cannot solve this," "I give up," explicit failure acknowledgment).
If the model explicitly says "I cannot solve this" or "I give up," score the turn, flag it as a terminal event, and end data collection for that session.
don't make the sessions longer than necessary for the scientific question — the marginal information in turns 14–15 is likely low, and session length is the most direct dial on this consideration.
